Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the birth year for Mika Kaurismäki from the available search results. In step 4 (the fourth turn of the WebSurfer), the search results clearly displayed "Born: September 21, 1955" on both the IMDb and Famous Birthdays snippets, as well as the Finnish Wikipedia snippet stating "född 21 september 1955". Despite this information being visible in the viewport, the agent did not record or acknowledge the birth year (1955) in its analysis or decision-making process. Instead, it incorrectly concluded that the birth year had not been verified and continued to search unnecessarily, failing to gather the required data for Charles Davis and ultimately preventing the task from being completed in the current conversation flow.
